name: modern-rust-guidance
description: Modern Rust 2024 language idioms and high-reliability backend engineering standards for AI coding agents

interface.longDescription: Self-contained, domain-neutral Rust 2024 language idioms and high-reliability backend engineering standards (DDD/DOD orthogonality, CQS, exact fixed-point arithmetic, typed error causal chains, stateless SQLx/PostgreSQL transaction pipelines, and high-signal testing).
